explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 96 named tracks and releases across Juno's same-day techno page, newly announced preorder listings, current-release label paths, Boomkat's preorder window and overlooked catalogue/repress material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The target state, canonical ledger, annotations, discussion and revisit queues, rejected state, discoveries, inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. Eight fresh exact-title leads from eight distinct releases remain; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.

Run 261's evidence guard was applied: one lead per release, and DJ Natas and Dopplereffekt alone have materially differentiating exact-track prose; release listings for the other six leads are treated only as identity and release-context evidence.

Source descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality was inferred. Neither protected handoff was split.
Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness or a fixed chapter map.

sourceWindows: CURRENT: Juno's same-day techno page and individually linked product listings, including Damaged Clock's 2026-09-15 release and DJ Natas' 2026-09-14 release, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/today/

ADJACENT / EMERGING: Newly announced forthcoming records from Nocturnal Expeditions, Concrete Soul, Planet Rhythm, Osmosis and Wolves That Drift were inspected at one exact track per release, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/today/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / RECIRCULATION: Dopplereffekt's Metasymmetry returned through a 2026 repress; Boomkat's exact-track account distinguishes Collapse of Simultaneity, while the original digital release date is preserved. https://boomkat.com/products/metasymmetry
